method: Metadata: Crossref / arXiv APIs via scripts/fetch_bib.py. Reported results: read from the arXiv abstract/HTML page of each paper by the author of this repository on the verification date; numbers are copied exactly. Items whose full text could not be read are marked and no result is attributed to them.
caveat: Published numbers come from different datasets, subjects, cameras, frame rates, window lengths, reference devices and rules for excluding measurements. They are contextual, not a ranking.

moustafa.status: arXiv preprint (v2 24 Jun 2025); no venue listed
moustafa.sensor: real event camera (Prophesee, 1280x720) + RGB camera (Brio, 800x600, 30 fps)
moustafa.dataset: proprietary; 64 subjects (45 male, 19 female), seated, stationary, eyes closed then open; ECG reference at 1 kHz
moustafa.method: supervised, modified TS-CAN (DeepPhys-style) on 2-D event frames (polarity accumulation per window; 144x144)
moustafa.split: 44 subjects train; 10 randomly selected for validation and testing (subject-level; text does not say 'subject-disjoint')
moustafa.limitations_stated: proprietary dataset; stationary subjects only; only the event-frame representation studied; event de-noising not integrated

jagtap.dataset: 25 participants, 46 recordings; dataset on Figshare (doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24039501.v1); reference from conventional methods / smartwatch
jagtap.method: unsupervised: per-tile dominant frequency (periodogram of 5x5 pixel tiles, 1/50 s bins) fused into one pulse estimate
jagtap.limitations_stated: flicker, hand tremor (3 of 6 failures), lighting variation, possible delay between exercise and manual watch reading

empd.status: arXiv preprint (17 Mar 2026); dataset on Zenodo (CC BY 4.0)
empd.sensor: real event camera (Prophesee EVK4) + industrial RGB camera; 660 nm laser illumination aimed at the radial artery (wrist), not a face
empd.dataset: 193 valid records, 83 subjects, 40-110 BPM, rest and post-exercise; finger-clip oximeter reference at 60 Hz; 9 archive parts (first part 46.4 GB)
empd.limitations_stated: the abstract page reports no benchmark errors

fusion_e2pulse.status: arXiv preprint (14 Jun 2026); listed as accepted to MICCAI 2026
fusion_e2pulse.sensor: event camera + RGB (dataset not named on the abstract page)
fusion_e2pulse.method: event-RGB fusion network for pulse-wave reconstruction

spiking_physformer.sensor: ordinary RGB video frames (no event camera)
spiking_physformer.method: hybrid ANN patch embedding + spiking transformer blocks + ANN predictor; claimed by its authors as the first use of SNNs in rPPG
spiking_physformer.version_note: Published journal abstract (read on the authors' lab page, which lists the DOI): 10.1 % total power reduction vs PhysFormer, transformer block reduced by a factor of 12.2. arXiv v1 and v4 abstracts (read directly): 12.4 % total, same 12.2x for the transformer block. The paper cites the journal version, so 10.1 % is used; the 12.4 % belongs to the preprint. 'Total' = whole model; the 12.2x applies only to the spiking transformer block. ScienceDirect and ACM pages returned HTTP 403, so the journal abstract was confirmed through the authors' page and a search-engine copy of the publisher abstract.
spiking_physformer.limitations_stated: abstract reports comparable accuracy to PhysFormer without numbers on the pages read; how power was computed was not visible

rppg_toolbox_unsupervised.status: arXiv preprint of NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks paper; numbers from Appendix G, Table 7 of the arXiv version
rppg_toolbox_unsupervised.dataset: UBFC-rPPG and PURE (PURE: 10 subjects, 6 recordings each)
rppg_toolbox_unsupervised.note: video-level HR from the whole filtered signal with a 0.75-2.5 Hz band-pass; the main-paper Table 2 differs slightly from the appendix; different protocol from our 10 s windows with a validity rule

nowara.finding: heart-rate measurement works across skin types under some conditions but average performance drops significantly for the darkest skin type, with a smaller drop for women

mcduff_compression.finding: first systematic analysis of video compression (x264/x265 at several constant-rate-factor levels) for imaging PPG, with stationary and head-motion tasks; details of the effect sizes were not read

dampfhoffer.finding: SNNs with integrate-and-fire neurons can compete with efficient digital ANN implementations only when spike sparsity is very high (reported range 0.15-1.38 spikes per synapse per inference depending on the ANN implementation); memory traffic matters

gehrig_video2events.finding: models trained on events synthesised from ordinary video generalise to real event data for object recognition and semantic segmentation (not for physiological signals)

hu_v2e.finding: adds pixel-level threshold mismatch, finite intensity-dependent bandwidth and intensity-dependent noise to video-to-events conversion; authors argue earlier idealised pixel models are invalid for real cameras

elgendi_sqi.finding: proposes a single signal-to-noise-based quality index for rPPG with a recommended threshold; full text not read

bent.finding: investigates sources of inaccuracy in wearable optical heart-rate sensors including skin tone and activity; used here only to caution about consumer wearables as references

shcherbina.finding: Apple Watch had the lowest overall error among seven wrist-worn devices; error was higher for darker skin tone, higher BMI, males and walking
